jobs.title: C# / .NET szoftverfejlesztő állás
jobs.description:
**Kövess minket!**

**Jelentkezem az álláshirdetésre**

Azonosító: 14396 Helyszín: Budapest XIII. Feladat: Full stack fejlesztés

Partnerünk 1989 óta a hazai piac meghatározó szereplője, a bér- és HR-szoftverek területén piacvezető és trendteremtő vállalat. Megoldásaikkal minden negyedik hazai munkavállaló találkozik a bérpapírján vagy mobilalkalmazásukon keresztül. Termékeik sikere a Kutatás és Fejlesztés csapat munkájának köszönhető, ahol a jövő HR-digitalizációs megoldásait tervezik és hozzák létre.
  
Csatlakozz a csapatukhoz, és légy részese a hazai sikermegoldások nemzetközi piacra történő felkészítésének! Egy olyan ösztönző környezet vár, ahol az innovatív szakmai tudás a korszerű webes és backend technológiákkal találkozik.

**Feladatok**
-------------

* Részvétel az üzleti és fejlesztői betanulási folyamatban, amely megalapozza a termékek és technológiák mély megismerését
* Agilis módszertan mentén, 2-4 fős dedikált fejlesztői csapatokban való hatékony együttműködés
* Kliensoldali és backend funkciók tervezése, implementálása és refaktorálása
* Megbízható, tiszta kód írása és az üzleti logika lefedése automata tesztekkel
* Meglévő és új generációs modulok integrációja, architektúrális fejlesztése
* Részvétel a hazai piacon már bizonyított bérügyviteli megoldások nemzetközi piacra vitelében

**Elvárások**
-------------

* Legalább 5-10 év releváns szoftverfejlesztői tapasztalat
* Magabiztos C# és .NET háttér (ASP.NET MVC, Web API)
* Kliensoldali / frontend webes tapasztalat (Angular)
* Relációs adatbázisok és ORM rendszerek mély ismerete (pl. NHibernate, Entity Framework)
* IoC / DI containerek készségszintű használata (pl. Autofac vagy beépített .NET DI)
* Automata tesztelési rutin és igényesség a kódminőség iránt (Unit / Integration testing)
* RESTful API-k és szervizarchitektúrák tervezésében, fejlesztésében szerzett gyakorlat
* Eredményorientált, minőségtudatos hozzáállás

**Előnyök**
-----------

* Tapasztalat az alábbi technológiák valamelyikében: Angular 1.x, WebApi, OData, Autofac, NHibernate, SignalR, FluentValidation, EPPlus
* Más modern webes keretrendszerben (modern Angular, React) vagy korszerű .NET Core / .NET 8 környezetben szerzett tapasztalat
* Nagyvállalati üzleti, bérügyviteli vagy ERP rendszerek fejlesztésében szerzett jártasság
* Angol nyelvtudás (nemzetközi projektek és piacra lépés támogatásához)
* Strukturált, tiszta architektúrális szemlélet (Clean Architecture, DDD, mikroszervizek)

**Amit ajánlunk**
-----------------

* Naprakész bérpiaci információkra alapozott versenyképes bér, az átlagnál magasabb cafeteria keret, teljesítménybónusz
* Valódi munka-magánélet egyensúly: rugalmas munkaidő, heti több napos otthoni munkavégzés (hibrid modell)
* Munkába járás támogatása: bérlettámogatás, zárt kerékpártároló, öltöző és zuhanyzó
* Családbarát intézkedések: nyári gyerektáboroztatás támogatása, családi rendezvények, munkatársi segélyezési rendszer
* Prémium munkakörnyezet: „A´ kategóriás, díjnyertes irodaház a Váci úton, tágas személyes terekkel és zöld erkélyekkel
* Feltöltődési lehetőségek az irodában: pihenőszoba, jól felszerelt saját tornaterem, reggeli közös jógaóra, teraszos programok és összetartó közösség

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test (SET) - GenAI Focus
jobs.description:
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer in Test** with a strong technical background in test automation and specialized expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) and AI-driven testing. In this role, you will lead the integration of AI-powered capabilities into our testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and quality workflows to maximize automation coverage, efficiency, and product intelligence.

**Responsibilities**

* AI-Driven Test Automation Strategy: Lead the design and implementation of next-generation test automation frameworks enhanced by Generative AI and agentic workflows
* GenAI Tooling & Utilities: Develop, maintain, and scale custom AI-assisted utilities, agents, and APIs for automated test generation, test data synthesis, self-healing tests, and intelligent root cause analysis
* CI/CD & AI Observability Integration: Integrate GenAI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines for automated regression analysis, test monitoring, and quality gating. Use AI observability tools to monitor the behavior and reliability of AI-assisted test components
* Test Automation & Quality: Build, maintain, and execute robust automated test suites across multiple programming languages and platforms, ensuring high code quality and testability
* Tool Evaluation & Innovation: Conduct evaluations of emerging AI-driven testing tools and GenAI models, recommending and prototyping the best fit for project needs
* Collaboration & Leadership: Collaborate closely with developers, DevOps engineers, and product teams to enforce best coding practices, conduct code reviews, and drive AI adoption across the SDLC
* Client Engagement: Demonstrate AI-based automation prototypes to clients, explaining their value propositions, assumptions, limitations, and architectural patterns

**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years of Software Engineering experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, DevOps Automation, and Software Development
* Core Test Automation & Programming: Advanced proficiency in test automation, with hands-on expertise in at least one core programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, or .NET)
* GenAI & AI-Driven Testing (Must-Have):
* Solid practical knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, prompting techniques, and AI APIs applied directly to QA and automation workflows
* Hands-on experience using GenAI tools to accelerate test design, automation code development, debugging, and synthetic test data generation
* Understanding of agentic workflows, AI evaluation principles, and AI model/system observability
* DevOps & CI/CD: Advanced hands-on experience integrating test automation suites with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
* Software Engineering Practices: Strong grasp of software design patterns, clean coding standards, static code analysis, and branching strategies (e.g., Git Flow)
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, ability to manage tasks independently, and excellent communication and presentation skills for client collaboration

**Nice to have**

* Experience building or orchestrating LLM workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
* Advanced skills in embedded systems testing (using Python, Java, or .NET) and experience with testbed creation for physical products
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and infrastructure monitoring tools

**We offer**

* Dynamic, entrepreneurial corporate environment
* Diverse multicultural, multi-functional, and multilingual work environment
* Opportunities for personal and career growth in a progressive industry
* Global scope, international projects
* Widespread training and development opportunities
* Access to LinkedIn Learning solutions
* Competitive salary and various benefits
* Advanced wellbeing and CSR programs, recreation area

Do you know someone interested in starting a career in IT? Share our EPAM Campus programs with them, where they can enhance their knowledge in various fields online, free of charge.

jobs.title: Business Application Expert Cross Platform
jobs.description:
Job summery

We are looking for a Business Applications Expert with expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing business application solutions across different business areas using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of business processes, system architecture, customization, integrations, and Power Platform to drive digital transformation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

* Collaborate with business users and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
* Translate business needs into functional and technical solutions within different technologies.
* Provide recommendations on best practices, process improvements, and automation.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams (IT, ﬁnance, and all operations) to align with business

goals.

* Can lead the implementation and conﬁguration of Business Applications
* Customize entities, ﬁelds, forms, views, workﬂows, and business processes within D365.
* Expert knowledge of system upgrades and apply Microsoft patches/releases.
* Expert knowledge of Dynamics 365 using Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse).
* Expert knowledge in custom plugins, JavaScript, .NET extensions, and workﬂows for enhanced

functionality.

functionality.

* Customize and extend Microsoft Copilot for enterprise applications (e.g., Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Dynamics 365).
* Develop and deploy Copilot Studio applications to automate workﬂows and enhance user

experience.

* Integrate Copilot AI features into Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook to improve collaboration and efficiency.
* Optimize AI workloads on Azure Machine Learning (Azure ML) and Azure Cognitive Services.
* Ensure secure and scalable AI deployments using Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure DevOps.
* Work with Azure OpenAI embeddings for enterprise knowledge search and document automation.
* Implement best practices for AI governance, responsible AI, and ethical AI usage.
* Ensure data privacy, compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and security in AI-driven applications.
* Monitor and maintain AI solutions, ensuring performance, accuracy, and reliability.
* Utilize Azure Logic Apps, API Management, and Service Bus for seamless integrations.
* Work with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for deploying updates and managing environments.
* Ensure system scalability, high availability, and compliance with security policies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, system bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
* Conduct training sessions and user adoption programs for end-users.
* Develop technical documentation, user guides, and training materials.
* Provide ongoing support and post-implementation maintenance

Technical Skills:

* 9+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business and custom

Applications

* Strong expertise in Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse/CDS).
* Proﬁciency in C#, .NET, JavaScript, HTML, and TypeScript for D365 customizations.
* Experience with SQL Server, SSRS, and FetchXML for reporting.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth, OData, and Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management).
* Experience with ERP & CRM workﬂows, security roles, and business process automation.
* Understanding of Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and ALM for managing D365 solutions.
* Strong knowledge of business processes in Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and Customer

Service.

* Experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions.
* Ability to work closely with stakeholders and provide functional consulting.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication skills to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Project Management Skills:

* Experience in IT project management, including scope deﬁnition, budgeting, and risk

management.

* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams and ensure successful project delivery.
* Proﬁciency in project management tools (Manage Engine Service Desk Plus, Microsoft Project, Trello).
* Strong understanding of stakeholder engagement, requirement gathering, and change management.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related ﬁeld.
* 14+ years of experience in business applications management, IT consulting, or enterprise software solutions.
* 5+ years of experience in project management (IT/software-related projects).
* Experience working in enterprise IT environments supporting large-scale business applications.
* Resource will be reporting to PM and will be responsible to execute any tasks given by PM.

Preferred Certiﬁcations (Not Mandatory)

* Certiﬁcation on AI technology
* Certiﬁcation on BI technology
* Microsoft Business application solution architect
* Azure Solution Architect.
* Project Management Professional (PMP)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in business applications management, IT consulting, or enterprise software solutions?

Experience:

* with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business and custom Applications: 9 years (Preferred)

jobs.description:
### **General Information**

Ref #

237116

Location

Qatar-Doha

Job family

Engineering

* Closing Date: 2026-10-20

### **Description**

**About the role**

As a Defect Control Engineer-Level II in Line Maintenance Production Control you will Ensure enhancement of overall aircraft performance and ensure continued Airworthiness by providing in depth technical recommendations on emerging aircraft fleet issues. This includes continuous defect monitoring and effective management of deferred defects. Ensure essential technical and operational support is provided, contributing to managing deferred defects to an acceptable target and maximizing fleet reliability.

**Operational Accountabilities;**

* Management of the fleet Deferred Defects and to ensure all are updated to expected quality level before due date.
* To ensure proper trouble shooting recommendations are provided following Technical Documentations review and reflected in TSR /DDs to effectively support Technical Production where applicable.
* Continuously analysis recurrent defects that require second level of troubleshooting to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Monitoring fleet defects through OEM health monitoring platforms (AHM and SHM) and proactively provide rectification recommendations through TSR in a timely manner.
* To manage component on hold, following the organization policies and procedures.
* To support Fleet manager with required information’s and reports as required by the business
* Collaborate with the technical department stakeholders such as Supply chain, Engineering, Planning and MOCC as to initiate CRMs, Maintenance slot request, and Component robbery as applicable.
* Provide Technical on demand guidance to production teams during Doha AOG and OOS events.
* To Participate in daily production meetings not limiting to Morning Operational meetings, Delay defect review meetings.
* To ensure all legislative and Company procedures are adhered to in order to ensure that the Company remains compliant and airworthy. To endeavor as far as practical, to ensure that aircraft targets are achieved.
* Comply with Company Safety Management System.
* Perform other department duties related to his / her position as directed by the Head of the Department

**Be part of an extraordinary story**

Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future, and build the life you want while being part of an international community. Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge.

Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.

### **Qualification**

**About You**

* High School Qualification / Vocational Qualification /Diploma or Equivalent (Type of Diploma Based on Role) with Minimum 5 years of job-related experience OR
* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with Minimum 4 years of job-related experience
* Minimum 05 Years of Certifying Experience.
* Degree or Equivalent Diploma/License in Aircraft Maintenance.
* Minimum 02 type Authorization in QR Fleet.
* QCAA B1 or B2 License.
* In-depth knowledge of company/regulatory procedures.
  

**About Qatar Airways Group**
  
Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination.

Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
